inspectedText: Tallies were receipts for government income originating in the Middle Ages. Residual two cartloads after abolition in 1826; Clerk of Works chose furnace disposal rather than open-air burning or firewood distribution. Catalogue identifies genuine medieval tallies c1293-1294 as similar examples, not the destroyed 1834 batch.
inspectionMethod: Actual body opened in session web tool; original bounded inspection summary and section locator. Not a stored HTTP body, full paper or snippet-only verification.
limitations: Correlated with Parliament fire account; not independent institutional corroboration.
Catalogue objects are surviving examples, not sticks recovered from the fire.
